_: US purchase-tax rules per state, beside data/states_us.json (rate, doc fee, note). tax: the name of the tax the state charges on a vehicle purchase. trade: how a trade-in reduces it: "full" (tax on price less trade), "none" (tax on the full price), a number (credit capped at that trade value), or "notax". why: one sentence for the app and the state pages. src: [url, label] for the trade-in rule. Checked 17 October 2026; Sales Tax Handbook is the compiled source except where a state document is cited (it was out of date for Maryland, Kentucky and Michigan).
